_about: Public-domain William Sherlock (1641-1707), Dean of St Paul's, father of Bishop Thomas Sherlock, for the Word Hoard: A Practical Discourse concerning Death, a Practical Discourse concerning a Future Judgment, A Discourse concerning the Divine Providence, A Vindication of the Doctrine of the Holy and Ever Blessed Trinity (1690), A Discourse concerning the Knowledge of Jesus Christ (1674) and The Case of Resistance of the Supreme Powers (1684), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 44 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

wsherlock-death: A Practical Discourse Concerning Death: By William Sherlock (printed for J. Osborn, 1751)
wsherlock-future-judgment: A practical discourse concerning a future judgment (London Printed for R. Ware [and others, 1749)
wsherlock-providence: A discourse concerning the divine providence: By William Sherlock (printed by J.R. for D . Brown, J. Walthoe, J . Nicholson, B. Tooke, J . Pemberton, and T. Ward, 1715)
wsherlock-trinity-1690: A Vindication of the Doctrine of the Holy and Ever Blessed Trinity, and the Incarnation of the (Printed for W. Rogers, 1690)
wsherlock-knowledge-christ-1674: A discourse concerning the knowledge of Jesus Christ, and our union and communion with Him, &c (London, Printed by J.M. for W. Kettilby, 1674)
wsherlock-case-resistance-1684: The case of resistance of the supreme powers stated and resolved : according to the doctrine of the Holy Scriptures (London : Printed for Fincham Gardiner, 1684)

_alternates.wsherlock-copies: Many other printings of Death and Future Judgment; the EEBO pamphlets of 1674-1700

_excluded.wsherlock-other: Thomas Sherlock's works (on the thomas-sherlock shelf); 'A papist misrepresented' (Gother's, answered by others)
